name: KanbanThing Dispatch Protocol
description: KanbanThing dispatch lifecycle callbacks and control endpoints for OpenClaw.

kanbanthingTargets.label: KanbanThing Targets
kanbanthingTargets.help: Explicit workspace routing table. Use this or workspaceMappingFile.

kanbanthingTargets.*.id.label: Target ID
kanbanthingTargets.*.id.help: Optional operator label for this target entry.

kanbanthingTargets.*.kanbanthingBaseUrl.label: KanbanThing Base URL
kanbanthingTargets.*.kanbanthingBaseUrl.help: Base URL for this KanbanThing instance.

kanbanthingTargets.*.kanbanthingApiKey.label: KanbanThing API Key
kanbanthingTargets.*.kanbanthingApiKey.help: Workspace-scoped API key for this target.

kanbanthingTargets.*.workspaceIds.label: Workspace IDs
kanbanthingTargets.*.workspaceIds.help: Workspace IDs routed to this target.

workspaceMappingFile.label: Workspace Mapping File
workspaceMappingFile.help: Recommended mode for per-repo keys. Maps workspaceId to local repo dir.

callbackPath.label: Callback Path
callbackPath.help: Path on KanbanThing that receives plugin lifecycle callbacks.

pluginSecret.label: Plugin Secret
pluginSecret.help: If set, plugin HTTP routes require x-kanbanthing-plugin-secret.

enforceCancellation.label: Enforce Cancellation
enforceCancellation.help: Block subagent spawn/tool calls when cancellation is active.

hardKillMode.label: Hard Kill Mode
hardKillMode.help: Best-effort cancel behavior for active runs.

emitProgressEvents.label: Emit Progress Events
emitProgressEvents.help: Emit throttled ticket.progress callbacks from tool hooks.

internalApiPathHint.label: Internal API Path Hint
internalApiPathHint.help: Optional absolute path hint to OpenClaw internal dist for hard-kill imports.

mappingAllowedRepoRoots.label: Allowed Repo Roots
mappingAllowedRepoRoots.help: Optional repo root allowlist for workspace mapping endpoints. Defaults to $HOME.
